leads.title: Constitution of Mato Grosso (1989), Article 10, item III
leads.documents: State-level prohibition of discrimination based on sexual orientation; establishes state must guarantee no one harmed or privileged on account of sexual orientation among other categories.

leads.documents: Documented enforcement incident: trans woman expelled from pizzeria in Feliz Natal after using women's restroom; owner taken to police station for gender identity discrimination, released 2 November after custody hearing; under investigation as of 16 September 2026.

leads.documents: State rights machinery ruling: struck down Sinop law of 9 March 2022 (effective March 14) prohibiting distribution of educational materials containing 'gender ideology'; Appellate Judge Maria Aparecida Ribeiro stated violation of Federal and State Constitutions.
